children: Siechel Transystem's scouting division is not interested in a whole planet but rather in a specific resource. Siechel Transystem seeks out water-rich planets and sells the water to other planets that need it. Siechel scouts negotiate water contracts with planets and haul water across the galaxy. Siechel agents have a good reputation as fair merchants who treat clients on both ends with respect and integrity. Siechel is contracted by
to set up a water convoy from
. The job is not glamorous, but it is steady work for Siechel's scouts and a great way for a young pilot to rack up flight hours.
